# Media player (`media-player`)

Art (a thumbnail, or a full-width banner while playing), title and artist, the transport buttons a player allows, a progress line and volume.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createMediaPlayer` (types in `dist/web/home/mediaPlayer.d.ts`): `.mh-media-player` (`.is-playing | is-paused | is-buffering | is-idle | is-off`): a compact card body, a labelled group. A `__row` with the 1:1 `__art` (`<img>` `__image`, lazy and without referrer, or a music-note `__placeholder`; `.is-empty`), `__text` (`__title`, `__subtitle`, a hidden state word) and `__transport` (only the buttons `can` allows: `__previous`, `__main` play/pause, `__stop`, `__next`). With `artLayout: 'banner'` and art, while playing, paused or buffering, the root gets `.has-banner`: a full-width `__banner` (`.is-square` or `.is-wide` from `artShape`, hidden from screen readers) sits above the row and the row drops its `__art`. A wide still fills the 16:9 banner (`__banner-image`); a square cover sits centred at full height over a blurred, dimmed copy of itself (`__banner-backdrop`). If the image fails to load the player falls back to the thumb layout. Below, when position and duration are known, a thin `__progress` line (`role="progressbar"`) or, with `can.seek`, a `__seek` range. A `__times` row (`__elapsed`, `__total`, hidden from screen readers) follows it. A `__volume` row with a `__mute` toggle (`aria-pressed`), a `__level` range and its `__level-value` ("45%") when supported. Idle or off (`.is-idle`, `.is-off`) the player is compact: title and play button only. Ranges commit on release: `onVolume(0..1)`, `onSeek(seconds)`.

```ts
export function createMediaPlayer(options: MediaPlayerOptions): MediaPlayerHandle;

export interface MediaPlayerOptions extends MediaPlayerData, MediaPlayerEvents {}

export interface MediaPlayerHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(options: MediaPlayerOptions): void;
}

export interface MediaPlayerData {
  title?: string | null;
  /** Artist, album or show. */
  subtitle?: string | null;
  /** Artwork URL; a themed music-note placeholder when null or failing. */
  art?: string | null;
  /**
   * `thumb` (default): the art is a small square in the row. `banner`: while playing, paused or buffering, the art
   * is a full-width banner above the row instead; idle, off or without art the player looks as with `thumb`.
   */
  artLayout?: MediaPlayerArtLayout;
  /** How the banner frames the art: `square` (default) centres a cover over a blurred copy, `wide` fills it. */
  artShape?: MediaPlayerArtShape;
  state: MediaPlayerState | null;
  /** Seconds; with `duration`, draws the progress line. Updated by the caller. */
  position?: number | null;
  duration?: number | null;
  /** 0 to 1. */
  volume?: number | null;
  muted?: boolean | null;
  can?: MediaPlayerCan;
  /** Accessible name of the player (default the title, else "Media player"). */
  label?: string;
  labels?: Partial<MediaPlayerLabels>;
}

export interface MediaPlayerEvents {
  onPlay?: () => void;
  onPause?: () => void;
  onStop?: () => void;
  onNext?: () => void;
  onPrevious?: () => void;
  /** 0 to 1, when the volume slider is released (or a key changes it). */
  onVolume?: (volume: number) => void;
  /** The new muted state. */
  onMute?: (muted: boolean) => void;
  /** Seconds, when the position slider is released. */
  onSeek?: (seconds: number) => void;
}

/** Every word the player shows or speaks, for translation. */
export interface MediaPlayerLabels {
  player: string;
  playback: string;
  play: string;
  pause: string;
  stop: string;
  next: string;
  previous: string;
  mute: string;
  volume: string;
  seek: string;
  progress: string;
  /** Title when nothing is playing. */
  empty: string;
  /** "{elapsed} of {total}". */
  of: string;
  playing: string;
  paused: string;
  buffering: string;
  idle: string;
  off: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createMediaPlayer, type MediaPlayerData } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let data: MediaPlayerData = {
  title: 'Lanterns Over the Quay',
  subtitle: 'Marlow and the Tidelines',
  art: '/covers/lanterns-over-the-quay.jpg',
  state: 'playing',
  position: 83,
  duration: 227,
  volume: 0.45,
  can: { play: true, pause: true, next: true, previous: true, volume: true, seek: true },
};

const set = (changes: Partial<MediaPlayerData>) => {
  data = { ...data, ...changes };
  player.update({ ...data, ...events });
};

const events = {
  onPlay: () => set({ state: 'playing' }),
  onPause: () => set({ state: 'paused' }),
  onNext: () => set({ position: 0 }),
  onPrevious: () => set({ position: 0 }),
  onSeek: (position: number) => set({ position }),
  onVolume: (volume: number) => set({ volume }),
};

const player = createMediaPlayer({ ...data, ...events });

document.body.append(player.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MediaPlayer } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function MediaPlayerExample() {
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(true);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(83);
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(0.45);
  return (
    <MediaPlayer
      title="Lanterns Over the Quay"
      subtitle="Marlow and the Tidelines"
      art="/covers/lanterns-over-the-quay.jpg"
      state={playing ? 'playing' : 'paused'}
      position={position}
      duration={227}
      volume={volume}
      can={{ play: true, pause: true, next: true, previous: true, volume: true, seek: true }}
      onPlay={() => setPlaying(true)}
      onPause={() => setPlaying(false)}
      onNext={() => setPosition(0)}
      onPrevious={() => setPosition(0)}
      onSeek={setPosition}
      onVolume={setVolume}
    />
  );
}
```
